# Things on the rim: a soap bar in its dish, a shampoo bottle with a teal cap, an olive sponge.
# Each its own object; the bake places the whole set once (origin at the tub's centre, rim at 1.3).
new
material new Dish --base-color 0.6706 0.6078 0.5569 --no-slot
material new Soap --base-color 0.8235 0.7882 0.6471 --no-slot
material new Bottle --base-color 0.6824 0.3647 0.2510 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.2941 0.4471 0.4314 --no-slot
material new Sponge --base-color 0.4667 0.4549 0.2314 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Dish --size 1 --location 2.2 -2.52 1.33
scale 0.8 0.36 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Dish
add mesh cube --name Soap --size 1 --location 2.2 -2.52 1.44
scale 0.56 0.3 0.18
apply --scale
material assign Soap
add mesh cylinder --name Bottle --vertices 6 --radius 0.22 --depth 0.8 --location -1.6 2.9 0.4
material assign Bottle
add mesh cylinder --name Cap --vertices 6 --radius 0.12 --depth 0.2 --location -1.6 2.9 0.9
material assign Cap
add mesh cube --name Sponge --size 1 --location -3.0 2.52 1.42
scale 0.6 0.34 0.24
apply --scale
material assign Sponge
select all
shade flat
export props.glb
